verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. A song. Let God rise up! Let his enemies be scattered! Let those who hate him run away from him.
Blow them away like smoke. As wax melts in a fire, let the wicked be destroyed in front of God.
But let good people be glad. Let them celebrate in front of God. Let them be filled with joy.
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Praise the one who rides on the clouds. His name is the LORD! Celebrate in front of him!
God, in his holy home, is a father to those without a father and a defender of widows.
God gives lonely people a family. He leads prisoners out with singing, but those who rebel live in a dry, sun-baked land.
God, when you went out ahead of your people, when you marched through the wilderness, Selah,
the earth shook. The skies poured down rain in front of God, the God of Sinai, in front of God, the God of Israel.
God, you sent plenty of rain. You refreshed your land when it was worn out.
Your people settled there. God, in your goodness you provided for the poor.
The Lord gave the message, and a great crowd of women spread the news:
"Kings and their armies run away! They run away!" The women at home divide the stolen goods.
Even those who stayed among the sheep pens found treasures: doves with wings covered with silver and feathers of shining gold.
When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan have many peaks.
You mountains with many peaks, why do you look with jealousy at the mountain where God chooses to rule? The LORD will live there forever.
The chariots of God are tens of thousands, thousands upon thousands. The Lord has come from Sinai into his holy place.
You went up on high and led captives with you. You received gifts from people, even from those who rebelled, so that the LORD God could live there.
Praise the Lord, who carries our burdens every day. He is the God who saves us. Selah.
Our God is a God who saves. The Lord GOD rescues us from death.
But God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy heads of those who keep on sinning.
The Lord said, "I will bring them back from Bashan. I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
so you may wade in the blood of your enemies, and the tongues of your dogs may have their share."
God, your parade has been seen, the parade of my God and King into the holy place.
The singers are in front, the musicians are behind, and in between are young women playing tambourines.
Praise God in the great gatherings. Praise the Lord, you people of Israel!
There is little Benjamin leading them, the leaders of Judah with their crowd, and the leaders of Zebulun and Naphtali.
Your God has commanded you to be strong. God, show us your strength, as you have done for us before.
Because of your temple in Jerusalem, kings will bring gifts to you.
Warn the wild beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Make them bow down with bars of silver. Scatter the nations who love war.
Leaders will come from Egypt. Ethiopia will hurry to lift up its hands to God.
Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord. Selah.
Sing to the one who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient skies. Listen! He thunders with his mighty voice.
Announce God's strength! His majesty is over Israel. His power is in the skies.
God, you are amazing in your holy place. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise God!
